Restore into a new database instance rather than over the existing one, so the current state is preserved while you verify the restore. 3. items.title: Database connection pool exhaustion
items.passage: # Database connection pool exhaustion **Applies to:** Managed Database ## Symptoms - Errors indicating no connection is available - Latency increases sharply as traffic grows - The database reports far fewer active queries than the application expects ## Common causes - The pool size multiplied by the instance count exceeds the database connection limit - Connections are not being returned to the pool after use - Long-running transactions are holding connections open ## Resolution
